provenance: PCB component identification from weekend work 2025-12-01
raw_note:
Hardware Component Breakdown:

CM504B Level Shifters (6 total):
- Function: Hex bidirectional voltage level shifter (6 channels per IC)
- VCC: MCU logic level (~3.3V)
- VDD: Head supply voltage (~9-13V, typically 12V)
- Channels: AIN→AOUT, BIN→BOUT, CIN→COUT, DIN→DOUT, EIN→EOUT, FIN→FOUT
- CD4504B compatible

Assignment:
- IC1: HP primitive gates (HP00-HP05)
- IC2: HP primitive gates (HP06-HP11)
- IC3: HA address lines (HA00-HA05)
- IC4: HA address lines (HA06-HA11)
- IC5: HA address lines (HA12-HA17)
- IC6: Mixed - HA address lines (HA18-HA21) + HP primitive gates (HP12-HP13)

Dual N-MOSFET Packages (7 total: Q7-Q13):
- Package: SOT-23-6
- Marking: 'DS01'
- Pinout:
  * Pin 1: Gate 1 (G1)
  * Pin 2: Common Drain (D12) → connected to VDD
  * Pin 3: Gate 2 (G2)
  * Pin 4: Source 1 (S1) → HP line to cartridge
  * Pin 5: Common Drain (D12) → connected to VDD (internally connected to pin 2)
  * Pin 6: Source 2 (S2) → HP line to cartridge
- Function: High-side switches for HP primitive lines
- Each package drives 2 HP lines

MOSFET Assignment:
- Q7:  HP00 (S1), HP01 (S2)
- Q8:  HP02 (S1), HP03 (S2)
- Q9:  HP04 (S1), HP05 (S2)
- Q10: HP06 (S1), HP07 (S2)
- Q11: HP08 (S1), HP09 (S2)
- Q12: HP10 (S1), HP11 (S2)
- Q13: HP12 (S1), HP13 (S2)

Signal Flow:
  SoC GPIO → CM504B (VCC→VDD shift) → MOSFET Gate → MOSFET Source → HP line → HP45 cartridge

Power Requirements:
- VDD must support 14 × 0.3-0.4A = ~4-6A peak current (if all HP lines fire simultaneously)
- Typical operation fires fewer nozzles per pulse to stay within current limits
summary: The printer uses 6× CM504B (CD4504B-compatible) hex level shifters and 7× dual N-MOSFET packages (marking 'DS01', SOT-23-6) to interface between the Nuvoton SoC and HP45 cartridge. CM504B chips convert 3.3V MCU logic to ~12V head voltage (VDD). IC1/IC2/IC6 drive HP primitive MOSFETs, IC3-IC6 drive HA address lines. The dual MOSFETs (Q7-Q13) act as high-side switches for the 14 HP lines.
title: HP45 Driver Hardware Components - CM504B Level Shifters and Dual N-MOSFETs
